response.original_title: Anesti Danelis: This Show Will Change Your Life
response.overview: A musical comedy special by Anesti Danelis, filmed live in Toronto. Blending absurd yet grounded observational humour with original songs on guitar, piano, and (yes, b*tch) a violin, this emotionally chaotic hour dives into the messy realities of modern life. From navigating one-night stands while living in an immigrant household, to spotting the signs your partner is cheating, stealing from work, and exacting bisexual revenge by sleeping with your ex’s parents, nothing is off-limits. It might actually change your life.
response.title: Anesti Danelis: This Show Will Change Your Life
